body:
Tested locally, works great for `material_override`  and `material_overlay` on `GeometryInstance3D`. Setting/clearing/changing any or both material properties, setting/clearing the shader in the material resource, and editing the shader (GDShader or visual) all update the parameter list correctly now.

There are some additional cases that have the same problem, but whether that should be in scope for this PR or another one I have no opinion on:
* `CanvasItem` has the same problem when setting the `material` property, or toggling `use_parent_material`. I didn't think of 2D when raising the original issue, so it's not mentioned there.
* `MeshInstance3D` has the same issue when setting `surface_material_override`, assigning a mesh that has a default material, or setting the material(s) inside the assigned mesh resource. The same thing (except for surface material override) applies to `MultiMeshInstance3D`. This I did mention briefly in the issue, but I imagine these cases could be a lot more cumbersome to fix.
